children: GridAI Technologies amended Interim CFO Anna Skowron’s consulting agreement, setting a $27,000 monthly retainer and providing for up to 250,000 RSUs.

$27,000 monthly retainer, replacing hourly and excess-hours billing; eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus and up to 250,000 RSUs, subject to continued service and plan terms. Agreement runs through Aug. 31, 2027, then automatically renews annually.
